# Deboa-Contrib

> **Deboa-Contrib** is a collection of extension crates for Deboa.
It offers a rich array of modern features—from flexible authentication and serialization formats.

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
deboa_extras = "0.1.0"
deboa_fory = "0.1.0"
```

## Quickstart

```rust
use deboa::{Client, request::get, Result};
use deboa_extras::http::serde::json::JsonBody;
use serde::Deserialize;

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct Post {
    id: u64,
    title: String,
    body: String,
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let client = Client::new();

    let posts: Vec<Post> = get("https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts")
        .send_with(&client)
        .await?
        .body_as(JsonBody, Post)?;

    println!("First post: {}", posts[0].title);
    Ok(())
}
```

## Features

- SSE support
- Multiple serialization formats (JSON, XML, MessagePack, YAML, Fory, CBOR)

## Crates

- [deboa_extras](https://crates.io/crates/deboa_extras)
- [deboa_fory](https://crates.io/crates/deboa_fory)
- [deboa_hickory](https://crates.io/crates/deboa_hickory)
